findings.summary: The documented forced-native count is not reproducible under the project's default env script; it was independently reproduced with the pinned fontconfig sysroot on the loader path.
findings.detail: The worker restated (did not re-measure) the v1.1 counts from docs/limitations.md V6 and disclosed this. The default suite reproduced exactly. A first ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 run without the pinned sysroot failed 80 native Skia tests purely from a missing libfontconfig.so.1 (DllNotFoundException), with Total 1595 / Skipped 20 matching; re-running with the pinned sysroot on the loader path produced Failed 0, Passed 1575, Skipped 20, Total 1595. Both documented counts are therefore accurate; the initial mismatch was an environment limitation, not a documentation defect.
